title: 7-Day Exam Preparation Plan
problem: I have an exam in 7 days and I don't know how to organize my time.
content:
1. List all topics you need to review.
2. Divide topics across the first few days.
3. Use practice questions to identify weak areas.
4. Spend next days reviewing weak areas.
5. Keep final day for light review.

The goal is to make a realistic plan rather than trying to study everything at once.

title: How to Create a Daily Schedule
problem: I waste too much time and cannot finish my daily tasks.
content:
1. Write down everything you need to do.
2. Pick the three most important tasks.
3. Give each important task a specific time block.
4. Leave extra time between tasks for buffer.
5. Review your progress at the end of the day.

Start with a schedule you can follow, then improve it over time.

title: How to Cook Perfect Rice
problem: My rice is either too hard or too mushy every time.
content:
1. Rinse rice with water 2-3 times until water is clear.
2. Use 1:1.5 ratio of rice to water.
3. Bring to boil, then reduce heat to low.
4. Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
5. Let it rest for 5 minutes before opening.

Don't open the lid while cooking. The resting time is crucial.

title: Starting a Fitness Routine for Beginners
problem: I want to exercise but don't know where to start.
content:
1. Start with 20-30 minutes, 3 times per week.
2. Choose activities you enjoy (walking, cycling, swimming).
3. Warm up for 5 minutes before exercising.
4. Cool down and stretch for 5 minutes after.
5. Gradually increase duration and intensity.

Consistency matters more than intensity. Start slow and build gradually.

title: Understanding Basic Passwords & Security
problem: I don't understand how to keep my online accounts safe.
content:
1. Use passwords with at least 12 characters.
2. Mix uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols.
3. Don't reuse passwords across different accounts.
4. Enable two-factor authentication when available.
5. Never share your password with anyone.

A strong password is your first line of defense against hacking.

title: How to Organize Your Study Notes
problem: My notes are messy and I can't find anything when I need it.
content:
1. Use one notebook per subject or use sections.
2. Write date and topic at the top of each page.
3. Use clear headings and subheadings.
4. Leave margins for additional notes.
5. Color-code important points.
6. Review and reorganize notes weekly.

Well-organized notes save time and improve retention.

title: Time Management: The Pomodoro Technique
problem: I can't focus for long periods and get easily distracted.
content:
1. Work for 25 minutes without any distractions.
2. Take a 5-minute break.
3. After 4 cycles, take a longer 15-30 minute break.
4. During work, silence notifications.
5. Track completed pomodoros.

This technique improves focus and prevents burnout.

title: Basic Vegetable Cutting Techniques
problem: I'm slow at preparing vegetables and often cut myself.
content:
1. Always use a sharp knife (safer than dull ones).
2. Use the 'claw grip' to hold vegetables safely.
3. Keep your knife tip on the board.
4. Use rocking motion for mincing.
5. Practice on softer vegetables first.

Proper technique prevents injuries and saves time.

title: Building Healthy Eating Habits
problem: I eat junk food constantly even though I want to be healthier.
content:
1. Plan meals for the week ahead.
2. Keep healthy snacks visible and accessible.
3. Eat slowly and chew thoroughly.
4. Drink water before reaching for food.
5. Don't shop when hungry.
6. Make one change at a time.

Small, consistent changes lead to lasting habits.

title: How to Read a Book Effectively
problem: I read but don't remember anything afterward.
content:
1. Preview the book (read intro, headings, summaries).
2. Set a purpose for reading.
3. Take notes while reading.
4. Highlight key points (no more than 10%).
5. Summarize each chapter after reading.
6. Review notes within 24 hours.

Active reading improves comprehension and retention significantly.
